name: Nestlé (Malaysia) Berhad
summary: Nestlé (Malaysia) Berhad manufactures food and beverage products in Malaysia and internationally. It operates in two segments, Food and Beverages and Others. It markets and sells ice-cream, powdered milk and drinks, liquid milk and juices, instant coffee and other beverages, chocolate confectionery products, instant noodles, culinary products, cereals, and related products. The company also trades and deals in nutrition products.
